title: Coulomb Law
learning_objectives: Connect the idea to a real-world example
voiceover: Watch how the diagram builds step by step.
Connect each label to the core idea.
Imagine two magnets as two people holding invisible springs between them. When they are close, the springs are tight and the force is strong…
Pause and restate what Coulomb Law means.
